description: Add exponential-backoff retry to OrderRoutingService.processOrder on transient downstream timeouts.
tech_spec: Modify OrderRoutingService.processOrder() to automatically retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms) on SocketTimeoutException and ConnectException. Use Spring Retry's @Retryable annotation rather than hand-rolled retry loops. Log each retry attempt at WARN level. Do not retry on business-logic exceptions.
brd: Partners intermittently experience transient network failures when the downstream service is under load. Currently these surface as user-visible order failures. Requirement: retry transient failures silently; surface only after all retries exhausted.
notes: Reviewer should reject solutions that add a new RetryUtility class — @Retryable is idiomatic.

description: Add a new GET /api/v1/quota endpoint returning the current quota for an identifier.
tech_spec: Add a new REST endpoint GET /api/v1/quota that accepts an identifier query parameter (e.g. user@example), looks up the current quota via an existing QuotaService, and returns JSON {"identifier": "user@example", "quota_remaining": 1000}. Use @RestController, @GetMapping, @RequestParam with @NotBlank validation. Return 404 if the identifier is not found, 400 if the identifier format is invalid.
brd: Partner apps need a real-time quota lookup endpoint that does not mutate state. Must return the quota as an integer to avoid floating-point errors.
notes: New controller, not modifying existing one. Should reuse existing QuotaService, not create a new one.

description: Add a `failureReason` field to the OrderRequest entity and propagate it.
tech_spec: Add a new `String failureReason` column to the OrderRequest entity (nullable, max 500 chars). Update the JPA mapping, add getter/setter, and ensure the field is populated in the error-handling path of OrderRoutingService.processOrder(). When an order fails, set failureReason to the exception message (truncated to 500 chars).
brd: Ops team currently has no visibility into why specific orders failed. They need failureReason persisted on the OrderRequest row for retrospective triage.
notes: Requires a database migration in practice — not tested here but mentioned in notes to reviewer.

description: Add a NetworkTimeoutException and throw it from OrderRoutingService on routing timeouts.
tech_spec: Create a new checked exception class NetworkTimeoutException extending RuntimeException with (String message, Throwable cause) constructors. Modify OrderRoutingService.processOrder() to catch SocketTimeoutException and rethrow as NetworkTimeoutException. Add a @ExceptionHandler in the global controller advice to map NetworkTimeoutException to HTTP 504.
brd: Currently all exceptions surface as HTTP 500. Ops wants timeout errors distinguishable via HTTP 504 so dashboards can track them separately.
notes: Three-file change: new exception, modified service, modified handler.

description: Add a @ValidIdentifier custom annotation + validator and apply it on input DTOs.
tech_spec: Add a new custom Jakarta Bean Validation annotation @ValidIdentifier that validates a String matches the identifier format (local-part@domain — alphanumeric + underscore + dot in the local part, alphanumeric in the domain part). Create IdentifierValidator implementing ConstraintValidator<ValidIdentifier, String>. Apply @ValidIdentifier on the `identifier` field of the TransferInitiateRequest DTO.
brd: Currently identifier format validation is scattered across controllers. Centralize it behind a single @ValidIdentifier annotation so all request DTOs get consistent validation.
notes: Bean Validation idiom — annotation + validator pair.

description: Add a tenacity-style retry decorator to a Python service method (Python case).
tech_spec: Add a `@retry_with_backoff(max_attempts=3, base_delay=0.1)` decorator to the `process_order` method of `OrderRoutingService` in `app/services/order_routing.py`. Decorator must catch only TimeoutError + ConnectionError; log each attempt at WARNING; raise the last exception if all attempts exhausted. Use the existing `app.core.retry` module if it has a backoff helper, otherwise add one alongside.
brd: Python services intermittently fail on transient network errors. Need silent retries with backoff before surfacing the failure to upstream consumers.
notes: Python equivalent of cc001. Validates that polyglot retrieval surfaces Python service modules in code_change context.

description: Add a new TypeScript Express route handler (TypeScript case).
tech_spec: Add a new GET `/api/v1/quota` route handler in `src/routes/quota.ts`. Accepts an `identifier` query parameter (string, required); looks up the quota via `QuotaService.getQuota(identifier)`; returns `{ identifier, quotaRemaining: number }`. Uses Express `Request`/`Response` types. Add a `@types/express`-compatible signature.
brd: Partner JS apps need a quota lookup endpoint that does not mutate state. Must be type-safe TypeScript.
notes: TypeScript equivalent of the cc002 controller case. Validates TS retrieval + type-aware code generation.

description: Add a plain-JS identifier validator function (JavaScript case).
tech_spec: Add a new `validateIdentifier(identifier)` function exported from `src/util/identifier-validator.js`. Validates the identifier format: `local-part@domain` where the local part is alphanumeric+underscore+dot and the domain part is alphanumeric. Returns `{ valid: boolean, reason?: string }`. Pure function, no I/O.
brd: Frontend forms need client-side identifier validation matching the server's @ValidIdentifier annotation rules.
notes: Plain JavaScript (not TS). Validates JS retrieval + ESM/CJS-aware emit.
